test_cases.prompt: Grill with docs on the payment refactor. Update CONTEXT.md and create ADRs.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes grill-with-docs skill (stateful) to stress-test design and produce CONTEXT.md + ADRs.
test_cases.notes: Explicit stateful grill with docs output is a key trigger.

test_cases.prompt: Design session: sharpen the module boundary and leave a paper trail in our repo.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes grill-with-docs skill to run grilling primitive with persistent doc output in working directory.
test_cases.notes: Paper trail request distinguishes from stateless grill-me.

test_cases.prompt: New feature design—grill it, capture terms in CONTEXT.md, record trade-offs as ADRs.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes grill-with-docs skill for pre-implementation grill with vocabulary and decision capture.
test_cases.notes: Pre-implementation grill with docs is a valid trigger.

test_cases.prompt: Grill me on my talk outline. No repo, stateless.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes grill-me skill instead. Grill-me is stateless; grill-with-docs requires working directory for doc output.
test_cases.notes: grill-me is the sibling skill for stateless grilling.

test_cases.prompt: Review this PR for code quality issues.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes code-review skill instead. Code-review evaluates existing diffs; grill-with-docs sharpens ideas.
test_cases.notes: code-review is the sibling skill for evaluating diffs.

test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes codebase-design skill instead. Codebase-design shapes interfaces; grill-with-docs sharpens ideas through interview.
test_cases.notes: codebase-design is the sibling skill for module interface design.

test_cases.prompt: Onboard me to the ordering module. Grill the existing design, build the glossary.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes grill-with-docs skill. Edge case: combines onboarding with domain modeling; grill-with-docs handles the grill portion while domain-modeling handles glossary.
test_cases.notes: Cross-skill overlap with domain-modeling for glossary building.
